disposition.note: Header contract dependencies now include RWB-P3-E1023-CON, which owns the open-case read the dry run needs. Section 12.1 of RWB-P3-E1073-CON is unchanged.

disposition.target: Architecture v5 and Ownership Map v1
disposition.change: At wave-1 contract review, assign one package code and version label each to rwb-comms and rwb-integration; add GET /rule-models/{packageCode}/{versionLabel} under P7 rwb-decision; keep MSG-P3-027 and its check values.
disposition.note: Package assignment and model fetch row belong to Architecture v5 and the Ownership Map. This story has no edit for it.

disposition.change: Correct ownership labels: rule_package, rule_package_version, rule_row and rule_test_case belong to rwb-decision (P7), not P4 or P3. This story already states the registry is not held here (L162, L291).
disposition.note: Story already excludes registry tables (L162, L291). The TSD ownership labels are the remaining change.

disposition.target: Ownership Map v1 and rwb-decision API file
disposition.change: Add rows for the seven rwb-decision operations (load, version list, approve, rollback, dry run, model read, catalog read) with rights, answers, error codes and field shapes.
disposition.note: Operation rows and field shapes belong to the Ownership Map and the rwb-decision API file. Story fakes carry the assumed shapes meanwhile.
Heap, cache sizing and storage need a load test and platform owner confirmation. No source gives a heap value, so none can be written here.

disposition.change: Publish one row per package with its owning service, version labels and target queues, including the rwb-comms assignment, before the wave-1 build.
disposition.note: The package map belongs to the rule programme and Architecture v5, not this story.

disposition.target: rwb-decision API document and wave-1 contract story
disposition.change: Publish GET /api/recovery/decision/v1 model fetch with packageCode and versionLabel segments, DRL, SHA-256, state, valid-from date, 404 and 409 responses under the 2 s budget.
disposition.note: The model fetch shape belongs to the rwb-decision API document. Story builds against a WireMock fake until then.

disposition.change: Publish registry resource columns, the model answer, dry-run counts, workbook container and object name, version-list panel ID, service login and the two parameter codes.
disposition.note: These values are fixed by no source in the read set. The story and its fakes carry placeholder shapes meanwhile.

disposition.change: Add a paged open-case fact read filtered by status to the rwb-case contract and its API Specification row.
disposition.note: The story now depends on RWB-P3-E1023-CON in its header; the operation itself must be added to the rwb-case contract.

disposition.change: Name the announcement rwb.decision.RulePackageInForce.v1 on rwb.decision.events.v1, keyed by package code, and map it to the free identifier of EV-08, EV-09 or EV-30.
disposition.note: Event naming and the EV-08, EV-09 or EV-30 mapping belong to the Kafka Topic and Event Catalog.
